share.privacy: Encrypted in this window and never uploaded. OAuth tokens, cookies, history and network settings are never included.
share.tooLong: This selection needs a link of {{size}}. Links stop at {{limit}} because chat and mail apps cut longer ones short. Send it as an encrypted file instead.
share.linkNotePassphrase: The passphrase is not in the link. Tell the recipient through another channel. {{size}}.
share.linkNoteKey: The key is part of the link, after the # sign, so anyone who has the whole link can read the collection. {{size}}.
share.fileNotePassphrase: The recipient opens the file with your passphrase. Tell them through another channel.
share.fileNoteKey: The file cannot be opened without the key below. Send the key through a different channel than the file.
share.sharedVariablesNone: No environment variables are shared, because nothing here uses one.
share.sharedVariables: Only the environment variables used here are shared: {{names}}.
share.sharedCollectionVariables: These collection variables are shared with their collections: {{names}}.
share.includeVariables: Share variable values (off: only the variable names are shared)
share.literalCredentials_one: {{count}} request holds a password, token or key typed directly into the Auth tab. It is part of the request and is shared with it.
share.literalCredentials_other: {{count}} requests hold a password, token or key typed directly into the Auth tab. Those are part of the request and are shared with it.
share.nothing: There is nothing to share here yet.

shareOpen.title: Shared with you
shareOpen.intro: This link carries an encrypted collection. It is decrypted in this window and nothing is added until you choose Import.

key.label: Key
key.hint: This file was sent without its key. Paste the key the sender gave you.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: This share is locked with a passphrase. Ask the sender for it.

shareOpen.keepValues: Variables you already have keep your values.
shareOpen.activeContent_one: {{count}} item carries {{kinds}}. You are asked before those are imported.
shareOpen.activeContent_other: {{count}} items carry {{kinds}}. You are asked before those are imported.

shareErrors.unavailable: Sharing needs the Web Crypto API, which is not available in this window.
shareErrors.incomplete: This share is incomplete. Copy the whole link, or choose the whole file, and try again.
shareErrors.cannotDecompress: This share is compressed and this browser cannot decompress it. Open it in a current browser or in the desktop app.
shareErrors.tooLarge: This share unpacks to more than Gostman imports at once, so it was not opened.
shareErrors.unreadable: This share was decrypted but its contents are not readable text.
shareErrors.failedLink: This share could not be decrypted. The link was changed or cut short on the way.
shareErrors.failedKey: This share could not be decrypted. The key is wrong, or the file was changed.
shareErrors.failedPassphrase: This share could not be decrypted. The passphrase is wrong, or the share was changed.
shareErrors.unknownVersion: This share uses format "{{version}}", which this version of Gostman cannot open. Update Gostman and try again.
